name: RichMerchants
title: Rich Merchants - More Ore, Arrows & Bolts (native port)
author: L-Sypniewski (native port). Original mod: tailwindtom
description: Make every trader as rich as you want: multiply ore, arrows and bolts by anything from 1x to 100x on in-game sliders (default 3x) - merchants stay useful buyers and sellers all game long. Covers every trader, chapter restock and difficulty. Native AngelScript port of Rich Merchants by tailwindtom (Nexus Mods #161).
